written_by: the reuse-01 parent session, by hand, from run-23's accepted population surface and the thirty frozen questions of competency-questions-set-b.json only
cost_note: These thirty sets were typed by a person-equivalent session, not generated. The work was five tool calls: one that printed the surface's record types, families, subject slots and subtype closure; two that read the ledger entries E-0342 and E-0343 for the rule; one that wrote this file's companion; one that ran the closure check. No token figure carries that cost, and the amortization read in RESULTS.md states it as a separate line.
no_producer_ran: Nothing about run-23's graph moved. No ontology was authored, nothing was captured, admitted, disposed or replayed for this cell. The ledger at private/paper-v4-v4-run-23/ledger/history.jsonl was opened read-only and its sha256 was d5ef64c0ca6558967aa664705aa9661d3aec399d73c94aa7a5286ea6a991a908 before and after the query.
surface: run-23's accepted surface, 31 record types: ENTITY 25, EVENT 2, RELATION 4; subject-bearing Claim, Observation, CountObservation, GeochemicalObservation, GeophysicalObservation, ElementRatio; surface subtypes: CountObservation, GeochemicalObservation and GeophysicalObservation of Observation, ElementRatio of Ratio, RockSampleSet of Sample, ReferencedWork of Source, ResearchCruise of Campaign, SeismicEvent of Event, ContributionRelation of ResearchRelation, and every named type of Entity
method: one set per question id; a set lists the types the question is about and every surface subtype of each listed type (type_set_closure). Under v4.13 a listed subject-bearing type reaches its subject-carrying records whatever their subjects' types (SUBJECT_ANY), so subject types are listed for what the question is about and never for reach (E-0343). E-0342's lesson is applied directly: the carrying type is listed wherever the question asks for the thing it carries, which is why Instrument appears on every instrument question, ReferencedWork on every question that asks for a study, a dataset, a repository or a database, and the three observation kinds wherever a measured or counted quantity is asked for. Entity is never listed: it is the ancestor of twenty-four surface types and listing it would drag all of them in. Ratio, Sample, Source and Campaign are never listed as such; their concrete subtypes are, except Campaign and Observation, whose subtypes are all listed beside them. The two paraphrase controls carry their named question's set unchanged, so a difference in their coverage cannot come from the binding.

rationale.CQ-B-T1-01: the cruise as Campaign or ResearchCruise for its name and dates, an Instant for a stated year, Instrument for the units put down, and the observation kinds for the count
rationale.CQ-B-T1-02: the article itself as ReferencedWork (doi, publication_year), dated instants for receipt and acceptance, and a claim that states either date
rationale.CQ-B-T1-03: the ridge, the ocean region, the subsections and the neighbouring segment as GeologicFeature, the adjacency as GeologicRelation, a claim for what is said about the arrangement
rationale.CQ-B-T1-04: the three programs as SoftwarePackage with their access_url, the steps as Method, the place they are obtained from as ReferencedWork, a claim for what was used for what
rationale.CQ-B-T1-05: the deposited dataset and its repository as ReferencedWork (doi, access_url, source_kind, container_title) and the claim that deposits it or routes a reader to the raw recordings
rationale.CQ-B-T2-01: the authors as ResearchAgent, the credit as a research or contribution relation, a claim for a stated supervision or design role
rationale.CQ-B-T2-02: the grants as FundingAward with their award_identifier, the funded people as ResearchAgent, the attribution as a research or contribution relation, and the cruise as Campaign or ResearchCruise for the ship time
rationale.CQ-B-T2-03: the transforms, the stretch and the dome as GeologicFeature, the bounding and the position as GeologicRelation, a claim for a stated placement, and the observation kinds for a measured position
rationale.CQ-B-T2-04: the earlier study as ReferencedWork and the citation as ScholarlyRelation, the thickness as QuantityValue or an observation, the flank and the hosting layer as GeologicFeature, a claim for the inference
rationale.CQ-B-T2-05: the adopted ratios as ElementRatio, the compilation and the sample database as ReferencedWork with the citation as ScholarlyRelation, the analysed rocks as RockSampleSet, the segment as GeologicFeature, the claim for the purpose, and the observation kinds because the estimate carries estimation_proxy
rationale.CQ-B-T3-01: a spreading rate per flank and in total: QuantityValue, the observation kinds, a claim, the ridge as GeologicFeature, and the attributed work as ReferencedWork with ScholarlyRelation
rationale.CQ-B-T3-02: a duration as Interval or on the campaign, a spacing and a usable count as QuantityValue or observations, Instrument for the units, Campaign and ResearchCruise for the deployment
rationale.CQ-B-T3-03: two event counts and a location uncertainty as the observation kinds or QuantityValue, the relocation as Method and SoftwarePackage, the events as SeismicEvent, a claim for the stated outcome
rationale.CQ-B-T3-04: a bounded concentration on the primary melts: QuantityValue, the observation kinds, a claim, the sample set, the two segments as GeologicFeature, and the element ratios the proxy rests on
rationale.CQ-B-T3-05: pressure, depth and temperature at saturation as QuantityValue or observations, the claim, the solubility model as NumericalModel, the procedure as Method, the model's source as ReferencedWork with ScholarlyRelation
rationale.CQ-B-T4-01: the preferred causal claim with its hypothesis_disposition and assertion_modality, the feature and the events it is about, and the observation kinds for a counted set of alternatives
rationale.CQ-B-T4-02: the declined claim and its ground as Claim and Evidence, the compared ridges as GeologicFeature with their relation, the events, and the observation kinds for the morphology
rationale.CQ-B-T4-03: the declined claim and its ground as Claim and Evidence, the conceded nearby feature as GeologicFeature with its relation, and the observation kinds
rationale.CQ-B-T4-04: the hedged claim, the evidence record behind it, the events, and the observation kinds for the supporting measurement
rationale.CQ-B-T4-05: the flagged assumption and the asserted minimum as Claim, the estimation as Method, the ratios as ElementRatio, the quantity as QuantityValue or an observation, the sample set and the segment
rationale.CQ-B-T5-01: an expected bound and an observed range together: QuantityValue, the observation kinds, claims, the events as SeismicEvent, the segment as GeologicFeature
rationale.CQ-B-T5-02: a thickness with its uncertainty and a depth range together: QuantityValue, the observation kinds, claims, the flank and the hosting layer as GeologicFeature, the events, and the earlier study as ReferencedWork
rationale.CQ-B-T5-03: two concentrations from different parts of the text: QuantityValue, the observation kinds, claims, the two settings as GeologicFeature, the prior report as ReferencedWork with ScholarlyRelation, the sample set
rationale.CQ-B-T5-04: modelled temperatures and a depth cutoff together: QuantityValue, the observation kinds, claims, the thermal model as NumericalModel, the events, the model's source as ReferencedWork
rationale.CQ-B-T5-05: two segments compared on enrichment and concentration: QuantityValue, the observation kinds, claims, the ratios, the sample sets, the two segments and the relation between them
rationale.CQ-B-C-01: control (expected absent): asked as an instrument question, so Instrument, the campaign, QuantityValue and the observation kinds, which is the set a sampling rate or a sensor type would be reached through if the reading stated one
rationale.CQ-B-C-02: control (expected absent): a magnitude maximum on the event population, so SeismicEvent, QuantityValue, the observation kinds, an Interval for the recording period, a claim and the method that defines the scale
rationale.CQ-B-C-03: control (excluded surface): the compiled sites as GeologicFeature, the plotted depths and rates as QuantityValue or observations, the compilation as ReferencedWork, and a claim for what the text says about it

rationale.CQ-B-C-05: paraphrase control of CQ-B-T4-01: identical set
